scope: Read-only current canonical learned-branch/client-server rune inventory and implementation direction. No game/save/production changes or actual combat/playtest acceptance.
ownerRequest: Rework abilities, runes and related systems so every specialization is unique, useful and fun to play.
principles: Give each branch a distinct repeatable loop, meaningful moment-to-moment decisions, appropriate pressure response and useful solo/party/boss role.
Reach the full kit from that branch plus its shared starter at ordinary progression breakpoints; no cross-branch grants.

Cover every learned skill with real rune choices in coherent class updates, retaining stable existing IDs and current50/70/90 unlock cadence initially. Options should remain useful by situation rather than making the latest unlock universally best.

Review talents, combos, resource/cooldown pacing, authoritative effects, offline equivalents, target boundaries, UI/status/aim, animations/VFX and audio together. Do not certify rework from labels, damage inflation, catalog counts or dummy grants.
Preserve characters, earned points, selected branch, learned skills, equipped runes, hotbars/loadouts and valuable custody. Explicitly migrate only when identifiers truly must change.
Retain field-resource/town-recovery rules, ordinary equipment and control-immunity boundaries; demonstrate real learned casts with focused tests and device-readable feedback.
Begin with a complete Wizard class pass, prioritizing its rune-empty precision branch while retaining separate Pyromancer and control identities; then Fighter, Rogue and Cleric.
Fun and final balance remain actual playtest judgments; owner-deferred campaign/phone/listening feedback is not replaced by exhaustive automated campaigns.
